summary: Added LocalSettingsSessionHooks, the SessionHooks adapter that merges the app's three hooks (UserPromptSubmit, Notification, Stop) into the checkout's .claude/settings.local.json: it purges entries whose command substring-matches CT_SESSION_HOOKS_URL (so a stale command with a different literal port still gets dropped, not just an exact-text match), drops a group left with no hooks, and leaves every foreign entry untouched.
